capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: Additionally, as of December 31, 2025, up to $25.7 billion of share repurchase authority remained.

Our share repurchase program does not obligate us to acquire a specific number of shares during any period, and our decision to commence, discontinue or resume repurchases in any period will depend on the same factors that our Board of Directors may consider when declaring dividends, among other factors.
liquidity_notes: Recent 10-Q disclosures discuss liquidity needs and management's view of cash flow adequacy.
governance_notes: Recent 8-K filings include governance and board composition updates.
controls_and_risk_notes: Based upon that evaluation, our Chairman and Chief Executive Officer and our Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Strategy and Commercial concluded our disclosure controls and procedures were operating effectively as of December 31, 2025.
